items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: So he got some musicians together. He got me, he got Leo Williams

ctx.x: Yeah, he got... You know how in the summertime they want bands to come up on those jobs. You know what I mean. So he got some musicians together. He got me, he got Leo Williams, and he got another little young tenor player around here, he's dead now, named Sonny...
